findings_to_judge.finding: The US airline earnings cycle broke inside ABM's fiscal Q3 (1 May - 31 July 2026) and after ABM last guided: American cut FY26 guidance to a -$0.65 to +$0.65 range and guided Q3 to an adjusted loss of $0.10-$0.70, Southwest cut FY26 EPS to $3.25-$4.25 and trimmed capacity growth to ~1.5%, and Alaska suspended guidance and cut May and June capacity, on jet fuel of $3.65-$4.50/gal — while ABM's Aviation segment operating margin had already collapsed to 5.25% in Q2 FY26 ($16.3M profit on $310.8M revenue) from 6.34% a year earlier, and ABM runs 1,000+ conventionally fuelled shuttle buses and 2,000+ parking locations on largely fixed-price contracts.

The two closest public reads on the segment ABM said would drive its back-half step-up printed records for the April-June 2026 window after ABM last spoke: Comfort Systems reported revenue +50% to $3.27bn, diluted EPS $12.53 vs $6.53, and backlog of $14.06bn at 30 June 2026 against $8.12bn a year earlier, and EMCOR raised FY26 revenue guidance to $20.0-20.5bn from $18.5-19.25bn and EPS to $32.00-33.25 from $28.25-29.75 — corroborating the 'meaningful ramp' in Technical Solutions and M&D volume ABM guided to on 2026-06-05, in a stock that has not participated at all.

instructions: Judge EVERY finding, on both sides. Return priced_in_pct 0-100 and your own signed size_check_pct for each. Copy finding_key verbatim -- it is the join key and a typo silently drops the verdict. You have not been shown the hunters' own sizes or their reasoning, and must not try to infer them.
